public_derivative_method: Allowlist the exact test prompt, function arguments, fixed mock final, and partial-state marker; replace each other captured text fragment with its SHA256 and UTF-8 byte count. Retain request-body hashes, item types, and PNG content hashes. Authorization headers and image bytes are not stored in either summary.
public_runner_behavior: Apply the same allowlist at collection time so a future run does not write ambient Codex instructions or memory into public RAW.json.
notes: The exact initial local capture was preserved without rewriting as ignored RAW.private.json. The first AUDIT.json was generated against those private bytes before publication transformation. PUBLICATION_AUDIT.json independently checks the redacted derivative.
